record.question: Among the followings who won Nobel Peace Prize?
record.explanation: The Nobel organization's laureate list records Aung San Suu Kyi (1991), Jane Addams (1931), and Malala Yousafzai (2014). All the above is correct. Printed Jane Adams lacks an extra d; it uniquely identifies Addams in this context and needs a visible spelling note. Historical exam context: 2016-10 (month/year printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/peace/nobel-prize-awarded-women/ Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
